visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young man with dark, slightly wavy hair sits on a long grey upholstered bench in a bright, minimalist room. He is wearing a light grey turtleneck sweater and beige trousers. He looks around at the high white walls and large black-framed window before standing up and walking towards a large poster of a Dior perfume bottle on the wall. (2) The man is joined by a woman with short dark hair and glasses, wearing a black business suit. They stand together in front of white product display shelves. Both characters use animated hand gestures and facial expressions while conversing. The room is filled with soft, even light from large windows and indoor studio sources. (3) The man holds a clear glass Dior perfume bottle with a black cap, observing its details closely. He brings the bottle to his nose and takes a deep sniff with a pleased expression. In the background, modern exhibition furniture and blurred brand graphics are visible. He then holds the bottle up for the camera to see clearly. (4) The man walks through the exhibition space, which features multiple wooden podiums holding perfume bottles. A vintage wooden television set sits on a cabinet near a large promotional poster. The camera tracks his movement, showcasing the clean lines of the interior architecture and the intentional placement of product displays in the gallery-like setting. (5) The woman stands next to the man and continues her explanation with high energy, using her hands to emphasize points. The man listens attentively, his hands folded in front of him. They are positioned in a well-lit area with white shelving units in the background. Their expressions are engaged and cheerful as they continue their discussion. (6) The man showcases a Dior perfume travel set, opening a patterned black-and-white box to reveal several small bottles inside. Insert shots display an array of perfume bottles with various intricately patterned caps arranged on a white surface. The man concludes by walking past the large poster and standing confidently before exiting the frame.
